backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the GenMitra print platform backend, defining data types (products, orders, users, templates, cart) and implementing authentication, user profile, product/order/cart management, and admin seeding logic with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two features—fixing frontend TypeScript compilation errors and verifying canister configuration—to their relevant source files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing recent changes and responsibilities for components, pages, and hooks in the React application.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React SPA titled 'GenMitra Print Platform', mounting the app at the `#root` div and loading the TypeScript entry point via a module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component that configures TanStack Router with all public and admin routes, wraps admin routes in `AdminGuard`, and provides the global `QueryClient` and `Toaster`.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: A route guard component that redirects unauthenticated users to the login page and shows a loading spinner while the admin session is being checked.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a collapsible sidebar navigation, logo, nav links with active state highlighting, and a logout button.
Paginated customer reviews section displaying a grid of three testimonial cards at a time with avatar initials, star ratings, and previous/next navigation controls.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Renders an accordion-style FAQ section with six hardcoded questions and answers about file formats, delivery, sizing, returns, tracking, and bulk orders. Uses local state to track which item is open.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Displays a grid of featured or category-filtered products fetched from the backend (falling back to demo data), with add-to-cart and product navigation functionality.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site-wide footer with brand info, contact details, social media icons, and navigation link columns for Store, Company, and Support sections.
frontend/src/components/FrameStyleDropdo: Custom dropdown component for selecting a photo frame style, displaying a thumbnail image and name for each of five predefined frame options.
frontend/src/components/HeroBanner.tsx: Hero section with a background image overlay, headline, CTA buttons for shopping and browsing categories, and three stat badges (rating, orders, delivery speed).
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component providing a sticky header with logo, category dropdown, cart icon with item count, user auth menu, mobile menu, a promo bar, and a footer wrapping all page content via Outlet.
frontend/src/components/OffersBanner.tsx: Displays a promotional banner with a gradient background offering 20% off the first order using code FIRST20, with a 'Shop Now' button that navigates to the home page.
frontend/src/components/ProductCategoryG: Renders a grid of five product category cards (Photo Frames, Prints, Magnets, Mugs, Corporate Gifts) with icons and images, each navigating to the home page filtered by category.
frontend/src/components/ShopFramesBySize: Displays a grid of photo frame size options (4x6 to 20x24 inches) with images and labels, all navigating to the Photo Frames category on click.
frontend/src/components/TrustFeatures.ts: Renders a four-column trust/feature section highlighting Google rating, nationwide delivery, quality guarantee, and 24/7 support with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) modes, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminSession.ts: Manages admin authentication via sessionStorage with hardcoded credentials, exposing login, logout, and session state including a loading flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Wraps Internet Identity authentication and user profile fetching into a unified hook, exposing login, logout, identity, and profile state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including products, templates, cart, orders, user profiles, and shipping addresses using TanStack Query's useQuery and useMutation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, configures Tailwind CSS, and defines CSS custom properties for a light/dark design system with component utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/demoProducts.ts: Exports a static array of demo ProductInfo objects across categories (prints, frames, magnets, mugs, etc.) with placeholder image paths and product metadata for UI previews.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with TanStack QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard displaying summary stats (orders, earnings, users, products), quick-action navigation buttons, and a table of the five most recent orders.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettingsPa: Admin page for managing delivery pincodes, allowing admins to add or remove 6-digit pincodes via form inputs with toast notifications for feedback.
frontend/src/pages/admin/CustomerManagem: Admin page that lists all customers with expandable rows showing each customer's order history fetched on demand.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin page for viewing and managing all orders, supporting status filtering, status updates, custom image downloads, and production file generation.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductManageme: Admin page for creating, editing, and deleting products with image compression support and a modal form for product details.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TemplateManagem: Admin page for managing print templates with CRUD operations, image upload with compression, and a modal form for template details.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Cart page component that displays cart items, collects a shipping address with pincode validation, selects payment method, and places orders through a multi-step flow.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page that collects shipping address and payment method (COD, UPI, CARD, NETBANKING), validates inputs, shows a mock payment modal for non-COD methods, and submits the order via React Query mutations.
frontend/src/pages/CreateAccountPage.tsx: Account creation page that collects a username and optional email, triggers Internet Identity login, and saves the user profile to the backend canister.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Canvas-based photo frame editor page that lets users upload an image, adjust zoom/rotation/position, toggle portrait/landscape orientation, add a text overlay, and add the customized product to the cart.
frontend/src/pages/ForgotPasswordPage.ts: Forgot-password page with an email input that simulates sending a reset link and shows a confirmation state after submission.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page that renders a hero banner, category grid, featured products, and FAQ sections by default, or displays a filtered product grid when a category query param is present.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page supporting two modes: Internet Identity login for regular users and a username/password form for admin login, with redirect handling after successful authentication.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Displays a list of the current user's orders with status icons and color badges, fetched via useGetMyOrders, and navigates to individual order detail pages on click.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows a post-purchase confirmation screen with order details (ID, total, payment, delivery estimate) fetched via useTrackOrder, and provides navigation buttons to orders list or home.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Renders a detailed view of a single order including a step-based status tracker, ordered items with images, and shipping/payment info fetched via useTrackOrder.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Product detail page allowing users to select size, media, frame, and quantity, check pincode availability, navigate to the photo editor, or add the product to cart.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Inter, Playfair Display), CSS-variable-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, font sizes, and keyframe animations. Also registers the tailwindcss-animate and @tailwindcss/typography plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 55) describing a full-stack online printing/gift platform with Next.js frontend, Node.js/Express backend, Supabase DB, Razorpay payments, and Sharp image processing, along with architectural notes, known issues (auth failures, CORS errors, broken admin save), and a list of implemented features.
